title: 土星灯
description: 3D Carved Saturn Crystal Ball Lamp, Night Light, 80 mm 3.15 in Exquisite 3D Saturn & Ideal Present: Admire the lifelike 3D carved Saturn pattern, encased in a crystal clear 3.15 in 3D galaxy crystal ball; comes in exquisite present packaging, making it an ideal present for space enthusiasts and students Dynamic & Customizable Lighting: Featuring a square colorful light-up base with built-in LED, it offers seven adjustable light modes; easily switch among slow change, fast change, white, red, blue, and green light to match your mood or decor Soothing Ambiance Control: Create a tranquil and relaxing atmosphere with soft, adjustable brightness settings; whether for a bedroom or a serene office space, this saturn night light provides a gentle glow great for unwinding after a long day Effortless Touch Control: Enjoy seamless interaction with the convenient touch switch; a simple tap controls power, a long press adjusts brightness, and a double tap cycles through the various color modes, offering a user-friendly experience Wireless & Portable Design: Equipped with a built-in battery and USB charging capability, it supports wireless use, allowing for flexible placement anywhere in your home or office; charge indicator lights (red for charging, green for full) help you stay ready for illumination
